blocking_finding.title: No production-reachable invocation path for the real protected-presentation ceremony or the provenance-verified canonical-credential reads
blocking_finding.detail: run_protected_presentation_ceremony() (src/pcae/core/protected_presentation.py) and the provenance-verified canonical-credential reads (HumanPrincipalRegistryStore, hpac_rhamp_enrollment.resolve_active_credentials, ProtectedPresentationInstallationStore.resolve_current_generation) all require a *recognized* PRODUCTION HPACStoreAuthority -- one whose configured-agent identity has been bound by _run_recognition_sequence + authority._bind_configured_agent_identity (F-1 / HPAC-PAWA-REQ-022). Without that binding, _validate_production_boundary keys the negative boundary off the live process; the deployment owner (root) legitimately owns the tree with a write bit, so every provenance-verified read/write fails closed ('production HPAC root is not protected from the configured agent principal'). Observed live this phase: 'sudo python scripts/hpac_protected_presentation_admin.py status' raised exactly this.
the_only_ways_to_obtain_a_recognized_aut: (a) mint a pcae.core.hpac_protected_admin_writer.production_writer(<PawaOperation>) capability for an UNRELATED mutation (enroll/revoke/configure -- there is no read-only or recognition-only PawaOperation) and reuse handle.authority -- semantically dishonest (mints + audit-logs a mutation operation_id with no mutation), exposes a raw reusable HPACWriterCapability (prompt SS8), and is a competing-authority-path misuse (prompt SS8)

(b) the test-only seams HPACStoreAuthority._production_test_fixture / _topology_probe / _test_decision_source -- forbidden (prompt SS4 'no deterministic/test substitute', SS8 'no private test mint', SS21 'no test seam', SS79)
